blurb: Vibrissa Beer operates two locations in Front Royal and Winchester, Virginia, serving award-winning craft beer and American-style brewpub food. Both locations feature extensive outdoor seating including beer gardens and tented areas. They host events, offer catering, and provide special services for hikers at the Front Royal location.
extraNote: No smoking or vaping in indoor or outdoor customer areas · No reservations for groups under 15; seating is first come, first served · No delivery service; takeout and online ordering available
